findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of the page size
findings.body: totalPages is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. When the member count is an exact multiple of the limit (e.g. 100 members with limit 50), this yields 3 pages instead of 2. Because `showingLast` compares currentPage to this inflated totalPages, the 'next' button stays enabled on the real last page; clicking it sets offset to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)` = user_count, and the member list renders an empty extra page. It should be `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`.

findings.title: Public group members page now truncated to 50 with no pagination UI
findings.body: Previously, the members action only applied limit/offset for automatic groups (with a default limit of 200); non-automatic groups returned all members. Now every group is capped at `limit` (default 50). The public members template (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs`) and its route have no pagination controls — pagination was only added to the admin UI — so for any group with more than 50 members, the remaining members are no longer visible anywhere on the public group page.

findings.title: {{#unless automatic}} is never true in the member item view, so the remove icon shows for automatic groups
findings.body: This template is rendered as the itemView of `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` in group.hbs, so its context is the individual member (a Discourse.User), not the group controller. Users have no `automatic` property, so `{{#unless automatic}}` always evaluates true and the remove (×) link is rendered even for automatic groups — the exact case it was meant to suppress (the sibling `{{#unless automatic}}` in group.hbs works because its context is the controller). Clicking it on an automatic group fires the confirm dialog and then the server correctly rejects with 422, but the failure is silently swallowed (removeMember's promise has no error handler), so the admin gets no feedback. The view should receive the group's automatic flag explicitly.

findings.title: No upper bound on the limit parameter for the public members endpoint
findings.body: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` accepts any client-supplied value. Since /groups/:id/members is a public endpoint, anyone can request `?limit=1000000` and force the server to serialize and return huge user lists in one response. The limit should be clamped to a reasonable maximum (e.g. 200).

findings.title: remove_member spec uses xhr :put instead of xhr :delete
findings.body: The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' example calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42`, but the remove_member route is DELETE (`delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` in config/routes.rb); PUT is wired to add_members. Controller specs dispatch directly to the action so the test still passes, but the verb is a copy-paste error from the add_members test above and would mislead anyone converting these to request/route-level specs.
